name: integrated-lookup-toolkit
description: Unified Cyber Security Platform - Defensive Reconnaissance & Network Diagnostics

scripts.dev: concurrently -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "cyan.bold,magenta.bold" "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.start: concurrently -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "cyan.bold,magenta.bold" "npm run start --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.build: npm install --prefix frontend && npm run build --prefix frontend
scripts.vercel-build: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend && npm run build --prefix frontend
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
